claims.claim: Hurricane Isaias strengthened into a category 3 storm on Friday morning as it moved toward the US Gulf coast.
claims.episode_span: strengthened into a category 3 storm on Friday morning
claims.source_title: Hurricane Isaias barrels toward Gulf coast as category 3 storm
claims.supporting_quote: Isaias strengthened into a category 3 hurricane on Friday morning as it barreled toward the US Gulf coast, where states of emergency have been declared in Alabama, Florida and Mississippi.

claims.claim: Isaias had maximum sustained winds of 105 mph at daybreak Friday and 120 mph by mid-morning, and was centered about 145 miles south-east of the mouth of the Mississippi River, moving north-north-east at 15 mph.
claims.episode_span: winds rose from 105 miles an hour at daybreak to 120 miles an hour by mid-morning
claims.source_title: Hurricane Isaias barrels toward Gulf coast as category 3 storm
claims.supporting_quote: Isaias had maximum sustained winds of 105mph (169km/h) at daybreak on Friday, which strengthened to 120mph (195km/h) by mid-morning, according to the National Hurricane Center (NHC).

claims.claim: Isaias is forecast to make landfall Friday night along the Alabama-Florida line with seas up to 7 feet and waves as high as 30 feet.
claims.episode_span: landfall Friday night along the Alabama-Florida line, with surging seas up to 7 feet
claims.source_title: Hurricane Isaias barrels toward Gulf coast as category 3 storm
claims.supporting_quote: Isaias is forecast to make landfall on Friday night, somewhere along the Alabama-Florida line with surging seas up to 7ft (2.1 meters) and waves as high as 30ft (9.1 meters).

claims.claim: NOAA said damaging hurricane-force winds are expected over the Florida panhandle, southern Alabama and southern Mississippi, and residents should prepare for long-duration power outages.

claims.supporting_quote: Residents in these areas should prepare for the possibility of long-duration power outages,” the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (Noaa) said.

claims.claim: The EU and China reached preliminary agreements on hybrid car exports, market access and rare earth supplies after two days of negotiations in Beijing.
claims.episode_span: reached preliminary agreements on hybrid-car exports, market access and rare-earth supplies
claims.source_title: EU and China strike preliminary trade deal ahead of crucial leaders’ summit
claims.supporting_quote: The European Union and China have reached preliminary agreements on hybrid car exports, market access and rare earth supplies, offering a potential breakthrough in trade tensions ahead of next week's European Council summit.

claims.claim: The sides agreed to lower most-favoured-nation tariffs on EU products totalling almost 4 billion euros in current export value, estimated to bring at least 225 million euros in duty savings.
claims.episode_span: covering almost 4 billion euros in current export value and an estimated at least 225 million euros in duty savings
claims.source_title: EU and China strike preliminary trade deal ahead of crucial leaders’ summit
claims.supporting_quote: These range from car parts to olive oil and footwear, totalling almost 4 billion euros in current export value, which they estimate to bring at least EUR 225 million in duty savings.

claims.claim: Russia's draft budget would cut the federal cancer programme from 44.9 billion roubles to 3.87 billion roubles in 2027, from 148.5 billion roubles in 2025, while defence spending reaches 35 percent of federal expenditure.
claims.episode_span: cut its federal cancer programme from 44.9 billion roubles to 3.87 billion roubles in 2027
claims.source_title: Russia slashes cancer care as defence spending hits post-Soviet record
claims.supporting_quote: The federal cancer programme budget falls from 44.9 billion to 3.87 billion roubles in 2027 — a nearly 40-fold reduction against 2025 levels — as defence spending reaches 35% of all federal expenditure, the highest share since the Soviet Union collapsed.

claims.claim: Movement Against Cancer found household spending on anti-tumour drugs rose from 8.8 billion to 11.4 billion roubles in 2025, and about 94 percent of those drugs are on the essential medicines list.
claims.episode_span: household spending on anti-tumour drugs rose from 8.8 billion to 11.4 billion roubles
claims.source_title: Russia slashes cancer care as defence spending hits post-Soviet record
claims.supporting_quote: In 2025 alone, household spending on anti-tumour drugs rose from 8.8 billion to 11.4 billion roubles, and the number of packs bought independently increased from five million to 5.8 million.
